reason: Provides gate access information and lockbox code for a site that is missing from site records.

knowledge.summary: Access to the site near Kolari requires a key for the locked barrier at the start of the private road; the key is in a lockbox at the neighbouring red house with code 2580.
knowledge.author: Tiina Tuominen
knowledge.details: Key is in a lockbox at the neighbouring farm (the red house right before the barrier). Lockbox code is 2580.
